Aatrox.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If fights drag on because of the healing from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and Aatrox R World Ender, fit in Morellonomicon. Keep applying damage with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes to maintain Grievous Wounds.
Aatrox.fight: Look to trade just after Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance's empowered attack is used on a minion or Aatrox E Umbral Dash is used. Close the gap while dodging the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, and back off if Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses.
Aatrox.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes ahead of time, close in with an attack, then knock Aatrox up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. While he is airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land the remaining empowered attacks from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. If Aatrox looks ready to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Aatrox E Umbral Dash, first use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to prevent him from casting his mobility ability, then cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Aatrox.escape: The moment after you make Aatrox use Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to close in. It is a good time to trade if he has also just used Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance's empowered attack on a minion.
Aatrox.phase: If you avoid giving Aatrox an early lead and stack Feast, the game becomes more favorable for Cho'Gath as time goes on.
Aatrox.teamfight: Stand in front of your allies and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the path where the enemy is likely to engage. Silence them with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as they try to use a key ability. Cho'Gath has no mobility, so do not step even one pace beyond the frontline. Use Cho'Gath R Feast to reliably kill an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently depleted, and gain a stack.
Aatrox.laning: Keep the wave near your side and farm without giving Aatrox an early kill. When you are ganked, wait until an enemy closes in and commits to a direction, place Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to silence their chasing abilities.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main source of damage, so watch the cast animation and dodge outside or inside the hitbox at the tip of the blade. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave the area immediately instead of hesitating over which direction to take. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing is increased, so create distance and let its duration run out.

Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. You cannot walk away from the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution, and its second hit grows stronger based on your missing health, so preserve your health.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance and health first to prepare for Akali's main damage. Cho'Gath's primary damage is easily blocked by Akali's high magic resistance, so consider magic penetration if investing in offense. Cho'Gath R Feast's true damage is unaffected by magic resistance.
Akali.fight: Trade back when Akali emerges from Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack, and use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to stop her from casting her mobility abilities. When she closes in with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution, cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture to knock her up and trade with empowered attacks from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, do not chase; back off.
Akali.laning: Keeping the wave near your side makes it easier to punish Akali's engage and respond to ganks.
Akali.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes ahead of time and start the trade with an attack. When Akali stops to last-hit or dashes in to engage, knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while she is airborne and land the remaining empowered attacks.
Akali.escape: After dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip, look to engage when Akali W Twilight Shroud is also down. It is even better if Akali R Perfect Execution is still on cooldown. If only one mobility ability is down, she can escape with the other, so if Akali still has a mobility ability, prevent her from casting it with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream before looking for Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Akali.phase: Cho'Gath gains an advantage in the late game with Feast stacks, so fill up the stacks available from minions and regular jungle monsters during the laning phase.
Akali.teamfight: Stand in front of your allies and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture on Akali's approach path. Silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream just as she tries to use an engage ability. Akali briefly reveals her position when entering Akali W Twilight Shroud, which is also a chance to hit her with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Use Cho'Gath R Feast to kill an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently depleted, and gain a stack.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and the recall damage increases as the target's missing health increases. If you are cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself, and if your health is low, retreat before the recall. If you cannot get out before Aurora R Between Worlds appears, account for being slowed when crossing the boundary.
Aurora.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Aurora's main damage. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your max health, so be wary of choosing to build only health. If Aurora's healing lets her survive fights, fit in Morellonomicon.
Aurora.fight: Do not blindly throw Cho'Gath Q Rupture at ranged Aurora to start a trade. Approach after Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down, and if she looks ready to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with a mobility ability, silence her first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, end the fight and back off.
Aurora.laning: Early on, focus on last-hitting minions to get health and mana from Cho'Gath P Carnivore instead of forcing trades. Use Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes to hit through minions and clear while holding the wave, and call your jungler if Aurora pushes the wave in. After learning Cho'Gath R Feast, check for killable health thresholds and build stacks.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora still has a mobility ability, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes ahead of time, prevent her from casting her mobility abilities with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If you can knock her up first with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while she is airborne and land the remaining empowered attacks from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Finish with Cho'Gath R Feast when health has been reduced enough and the kill is certain.
Aurora.escape: Do not engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down. Your chance to catch her with Cho'Gath Q Rupture is after Aurora E The Weirding is also down and before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back.
Aurora.phase: Cho'Gath gains an increasing advantage as he builds stacks and the game goes on, so fill up the Feast stacks available from minions and regular jungle monsters during the laning phase.
Aurora.teamfight: Protect the space in front of your allies by casting Cho'Gath Q Rupture on Aurora's engage path, and silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as she tries to use a mobility ability. If no one is killed after Aurora jumps in, take the chance to catch her. Gain a stack with Cho'Gath R Feast when you can reliably kill an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been depleted.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses a wall to engage from a long distance and stun you, so avoid getting pushed toward a wall. Do not waste Cho'Gath Q Rupture during the untargetable moment as Camille engages with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Camille.build: Build armor first to prepare for Camille's main damage. Camille Q Precision Protocol's true damage cannot be reduced by resistances, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your max health, so be wary of choosing to build only health. If Camille survives with healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep, fit in Morellonomicon.
Camille.fight: Avoid fighting right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield; engage after the shield has been removed.
Camille.combo: If Camille looks ready to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, silence her first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then cast Q. When her mobility is down or she steps forward to last-hit, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes ahead of time, close in with an attack, and knock her up with Q. While she is airborne, use W and land the remaining empowered attacks from E, but back off if Q misses.
Camille.escape: Even if Camille E Hookshot is down, do not rush in if Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available. In particular, knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture before R comes off cooldown to make it difficult for her to escape.
Camille.phase: From midgame onward, Camille quickly takes down turrets in a side lane, so do not leave the side lane unattended. In the late game, make use of Cho'Gath's strength from stacking Feast.
Camille.teamfight: Stand in front of your allies and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture on Camille's approach path to delay her engage. Silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as she tries to use an ability, but do not waste a response at the moment Camille engages with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. Use Cho'Gath R Feast to directly kill an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently reduced, and gain a stack.
Camille.laning: Stay away from the wall and among your minions, and keep the wave near your side to watch for Camille E Hookshot engages. Last-hit to restore health and mana with Cho'Gath P Carnivore. Before Camille gets her first core item, pressure her farming when you can. When you are ganked, wait until an enemy closes in and commits to a direction, place Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to silence their chasing abilities.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you can easily get hit by his follow-up attacks, so poke from outside its range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move out of the blade’s range or hug him to reduce its damage and healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up, create distance to break the stacks. If you’re low on health with several stacks, get completely out of Darius R Noxian Guillotine’s range.
Darius.build: Build armor first to deal with Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Also build health, since Darius E Apprehend pierces some resistances and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate is a problem, fit Morellonomicon into your build and keep Grievous Wounds applied with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes.
Darius.fight: Take short trades after Darius E Apprehend misses or goes on cooldown. You can also poke just after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions. Don’t fight for long while Darius P Hemorrhage is stacking; back off to break the stacks.
Darius.laning: Pull the wave and hold outside Darius E Apprehend’s range. Once he closes in and his movement direction is clear, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to stop his chasing ability. Also reach the cap on minion and ordinary jungle monster stacks from Cho'Gath R Feast during laning phase.
Darius.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and close in with basic attacks. Knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land your remaining empowered basic attacks. If you think he’ll dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Darius R Noxian Guillotine, silence him first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back off.
Darius.phase: In the mid and late game, Cho'Gath gains an advantage as he builds Cho'Gath R Feast stacks, so secure kills and stacks.
Darius.teamfight: Stand in front of your allies and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Darius’s approach path. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to use a key ability. If you have several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage on you and Darius kills you with Darius R Noxian Guillotine, its cooldown resets, so get out of range when health is at risk. Use Cho'Gath R Feast on an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently reduced to reliably secure the kill and gain a stack.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend has missed or is on cooldown. If the slow from Darius W Crippling Strike is also down, you can chase when the situation favors you.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw deals damage based on the target’s current health and slows the first target it hits, so keep a minion between you and the saw. Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma increases his attack damage and empowers his basic attacks, so don’t stay close and fight for long. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so don’t spend time trying to kill him.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first to deal with Dr. Mundo’s main damage source, E Blunt Force Trauma. If healing makes duels drag on, build resistances first, then fit Morellonomicon into your build and keep Grievous Wounds applied with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and E Vorpal Spikes.
DrMundo.fight: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, he ignores the first immobilizing effect, so use Cho'Gath Q Rupture to draw it out, then look for another chance to engage. Once Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage has been spent and his health has been sufficiently depleted, finish him with Cho'Gath R Feast.
DrMundo.laning: Pull the wave and last-hit minions to get health and mana from Cho'Gath P Carnivore. Stand behind minions to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and after a trade, retreat along a path that lets you step on the canister Mundo dropped. Also fill up the minion stacks available from Cho'Gath R Feast during the laning phase.
DrMundo.combo: After Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and close in with empowered basic attacks. When Mundo steps up to last-hit with a basic attack, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him with W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land your remaining E empowered basic attacks. If Q misses, retreat.
DrMundo.escape: Engage when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw has either been blocked by a minion or missed. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so at this point look for a chance to catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
DrMundo.phase: From here on, Cho'Gath gains an advantage as he builds Feast stacks, so keep securing them.
DrMundo.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture along the enemy’s approach path. Silence them with W Feral Scream as they try to use a key ability. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, don’t fixate on killing Mundo; look for a chance to reliably kill an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been depleted with Cho'Gath R Feast.

Fiora.watch: Counterattack when Fiora uses Q Lunge to move toward a vital. If she hits you with Fiora R Grand Challenge, hug a wall to block one side’s vital.
Fiora.build: Build armor first to deal with Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. You can’t mitigate the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance or Fiora R Grand Challenge with resistances, and R Grand Challenge scales with your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. If healing makes duels drag on, build resistances first, then fit Morellonomicon into your build.
Fiora.fight: The moment after you make Fiora use Q Lunge is your chance to close the gap. Draw out Fiora W Riposte, then knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, don’t chase; back off.
Fiora.laning: Stand on the side opposite the vital to narrow Fiora’s angle of approach, then counterattack as she moves in. Last-hit minions to get health and mana from Cho'Gath P Carnivore and survive the early game. Keep the wave pushed toward you. If a gank comes in, cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture when the opponent closes in and their movement direction is clear, then use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to disable her chasing ability.
Fiora.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and close in with basic attacks. If Fiora W Riposte is down, knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while she’s airborne, then land your remaining E empowered basic attacks.
Fiora.escape: The moment after you make Fiora use Q Lunge is your window to engage. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, use Cho'Gath Q Rupture and take a short trade. If Riposte is still available, don’t cast Rupture carelessly.
Fiora.phase: In the late game, don’t face Fiora alone in a side lane. Use at least two players to catch her, or force a team fight.
Fiora.teamfight: Stand in front of your allies and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Fiora’s approach path. Silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as she tries to use a key ability. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, hug a wall so you don’t expose all four vitals. Use Cho'Gath R Feast on the enemy’s main damage dealer once their health is low enough to secure the kill and gain a stack.

Gangplank.watch: Back off when Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, and don’t enter an area where two kegs overlap. You can reduce the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage with resistances, so be especially careful when your health is low.
Gangplank.build: Build armor first from laning phase to withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley poke. Also build health to deal with true damage. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy’s healing makes a fight drag on, fit Morellonomicon into your build.
Gangplank.fight: The moment after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed is your chance to trade; back off if there’s a primed keg nearby. After Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. He can’t cleanse the crowd control, making it a good time to engage.
Gangplank.laning: Keep the wave pushed toward you, and stay at a distance from primed Gangplank E Powder Kegs. If a gank comes in, cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture when the opponent closes in and their movement direction is fixed, then use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to stop him from chasing.
Gangplank.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and close in. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land your remaining empowered basic attacks. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back off.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage just after he places Gangplank E Powder Keg and when Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down. Catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then follow up with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream.
Gangplank.phase: In the mid and late game, Cho'Gath gains an advantage as he builds stacks, but you can’t count on that advantage if you miss out on stacks.
Gangplank.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture along the enemy’s approach path. Use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream on enemies as they try to use a key ability. Track whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used to choose when to fight over an objective. Use Cho'Gath R Feast on the enemy’s main damage dealer once their health has been reduced enough to secure the kill and gain a stack.

Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack applies silence and prevents you from retaliating, so don't engage first while it's active. When Garen E Judgment starts, don't stay close for long; move out of its spin range. Garen W Courage grants a shield and tenacity immediately after activation, so delay Cho'Gath Q Rupture by half a beat. When your health drops below half, watch for Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals damage based on your missing health, and stay out of its range.
Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so don't count on resistances to withstand it; build health instead. If Garen P Perseverance's healing is a problem, fit in Morellonomicon and keep up the healing reduction with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes.
Garen.fight: Start a short trade just after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack is used or expires. Slow him with Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes and knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, but delay Q if Garen W Courage was just activated. Don't stay close for long while taking damage from Garen E Judgment; finish the trade and back off.
Garen.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes ahead of time, close in with an empowered attack, then knock Garen up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. While he's airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land your remaining E empowered attacks. Delay Q by half a beat if Garen W Courage was just activated, and back off if Q misses.
Garen.escape: Your window to engage Garen is immediately after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack is used on a minion or otherwise spent. Garen has no mobility spell, so catch him then with the slow from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes and the knock-up from Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If Garen E Judgment starts or Q misses, don't prolong the trade; back off.
Garen.phase: As the game goes on, Garen builds permanent stacks from Garen W Courage, so keep up the pressure and build Cho'Gath's R stacks too.
Garen.teamfight: Guard the space in front of your allies and place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Garen's path to delay his engage. When Garen is about to use a key ability, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, but delay Q if Garen W Courage was just activated. When you can reliably kill the enemy team's main damage dealer whose health has been reduced with Cho'Gath R Feast, take the stack.

Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw can hit on both the way out and the way back, so step out of its path. Avoid direct fights when Gnar's Rage is full and he is about to turn into Mega Gnar. Mega Gnar R GNAR! stuns you if you hit a wall, so don't stand with your back to one.
Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar's main damage sources: Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, E Hop / Crunch, and R GNAR!. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so don't expect armor or health alone to block all of it. Consider tenacity if you're worried about Mega Gnar R GNAR!'s wall stun.
Gnar.fight: Don't throw Cho'Gath Q Rupture recklessly while taking ranged harass from Mini Gnar. Close the distance just after Gnar uses E Hop / Crunch or transforms from Mega Gnar back into Mini Gnar. If Gnar looks ready to dodge Q with E Hop / Crunch, silence him first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then place Q Rupture.
Gnar.laning: Early on, farm near your turret and use Cho'Gath P Carnivore's healing to sustain. Clear minions by piercing them with Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, and call for a jungle gank if Gnar pushes the wave. During lane phase, also fill out the stacks available from minions and regular jungle monsters with Cho'Gath R Feast.
Gnar.combo: When you can close in, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes ahead of time, slow Gnar with an empowered attack, then knock him up with Q Rupture. Silence airborne Gnar with W Feral Scream and land your remaining E empowered attacks.
Gnar.phase: Building Feast stacks gives Cho'Gath an advantage as the game goes on, but without stacks, he's still just an ordinary melee champion in the late game.
Gnar.teamfight: Don't fight Mega Gnar head-on just after he transforms; wait out the transformation. Don't fight with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain. Place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Gnar's path as he engages and silence him with W Feral Scream when he's about to use a key ability. Guard the space in front of your allies, then use R Feast to secure a kill on an enemy team's main damage dealer once their health has been reduced enough, and gain a stack.
Gnar.escape: The moment after Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch is Cho'Gath’s window to engage. Gnar also cannot transform again for a while after changing from Mega Gnar back to Mini Gnar, so look for a fight then. Conversely, create distance if Mega Gnar has just transformed or is positioned to stun you against a wall with Gnar R GNAR!.

Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals dangerous true damage, so walk sideways out of it as she casts. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on your maximum health, so don't stay close just because you have a lot of health. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can't target her from outside it, so use Cho'Gath R Feast from inside the mist or after it ends.
Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen's main damage and consider items like Spectre's Cowl. Also build some armor against the physical damage from her basic attacks. If Gwen P A Thousand Cuts' healing is a problem, fit in Morellonomicon and keep up the healing reduction with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes.
Gwen.fight: Look for an opening before Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s stacks are full or just after she uses Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, slow her with Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, then hit her with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and continue the trade.
Gwen.laning: Pull the wave toward your side to guard against ganks, and use minion last hits to restore health and mana with Cho'Gath P Carnivore. Deny Gwen opportunities to land basic attacks and heal. Build Cho'Gath R Feast's minion stacks up to the cap during lane phase, but don't use it carelessly as a finisher if a kill isn't certain.
Gwen.combo: Before closing in, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes and land an empowered attack, then knock Gwen up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. While she's airborne, cast Cho'Gath W Feral Scream on her and land your remaining empowered attacks. If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash looks ready to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence her first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then place Q Rupture. Back off if Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses.
Gwen.escape: Close the distance just after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used. If you place Cho'Gath Q Rupture then, Gwen will have trouble dodging it with her mobility spell, and you can also silence her first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream.
Gwen.phase: Building Feast stacks consistently gives Cho'Gath an increasing advantage as the game goes on, but missing stacks reduces his late-game strength too.
Gwen.teamfight: Stand in front of your allies and place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Gwen's path as she engages; silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream when she's about to use a key ability. Keep your distance with Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s center and Gwen R Needlework's damage based on maximum health in mind. Use Cho'Gath R Feast on an enemy team's main damage dealer once their health has been reduced enough to secure a kill and gain a stack.

Illaoi.watch: Getting hit by Illaoi E Test of Spirit puts you at a disadvantage because of its slow and mark, so dodge it and last-hit from outside its range. Illaoi R Leap of Faith makes her area damage and tentacles threatening, so spread out and keep your distance until it ends.
Illaoi.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson.
Illaoi.laning: Pull the wave toward your side, but don't fight near walls where tentacles are set up. Look to last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit's range and away from walls. Restore health and mana through minion kills with Cho'Gath P Carnivore, and build Cho'Gath R Feast's minion and regular jungle monster stacks up to the cap during lane phase.
Illaoi.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes ahead of time, close in with a basic attack, then knock Illaoi up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. While she's airborne, silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then land your remaining empowered attacks. If Illaoi W Harsh Lesson looks ready to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture, cast Cho'Gath W Feral Scream first to lock down her mobility spell, then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Illaoi.escape: Look to engage just after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson or after you dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit. If Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is still available, you can silence her first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, but she can still walk out of Cho'Gath Q Rupture while silenced, so watch her movement before placing it.
Illaoi.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger as he builds stacks and gains an advantage as the game goes on, so build Feast stacks for the late game.
Illaoi.teamfight: Avoid walls with tentacles set up, and spread out from your team when Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith to wait out its duration. Stand in front of your allies and place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along the engage path; silence Illaoi with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream when she's about to use a key ability. Use Cho'Gath R Feast to kill an enemy team's main damage dealer once their health is low enough, and gain a stack.
Illaoi.fight: The moment after Illaoi uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is your chance to close the distance. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back away.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the distance, so back away when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Build armor first to withstand Irelia’s main damage. If she sustains through Irelia Q Bladesurge, work Morellonomicon into your build and keep healing reduction up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes.
Irelia.fight: Close the distance and fight right after baiting out Irelia Q Bladesurge. If she still has a dash, silence her first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to lock down her mobility, then look for Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back off.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave low-health minions between you and Irelia. Let the lane push toward you and watch for her chained approaches with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Irelia.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and engage with empowered basic attacks. If Irelia Q Bladesurge is still available, silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture and land your remaining empowered basic attacks while she’s airborne. If Irelia Q Bladesurge is on cooldown, knock her up first with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while she’s airborne.
Irelia.escape: The moment after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge is your window to engage. Look for Cho'Gath Q Rupture then, and engage more safely if Irelia E Flawless Duet is also on cooldown.
Irelia.phase: After that, surviving the early game and building more Cho'Gath R Feast stacks makes the matchup increasingly favorable.
Irelia.teamfight: Stand in front of your allies and place Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Irelia’s approach path, then silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as she tries to cast a spell. Irelia can have a major impact in teamfights with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet, so pressure her first. If Irelia’s health is low enough for Cho'Gath R Feast to secure the kill, take the stack.

Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, he dodges basic attacks, including those empowered by Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, and its recast damage increases with each attack dodged. Stop basic attacks and move outside the stun’s range until Counter Strike ends. Jax can activate it after closing in with Jax Q Leap Strike, so watch for both abilities.
Jax.build: Against Jax, whose damage relies on attack speed, consider defensive options that reduce his attack speed first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Jax.fight: Use the end of Jax E Counter Strike as your trading window. If he has also used Jax Q Leap Strike, block his escape with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Use Cho'Gath R Feast to finish only when you’re sure enough health has been removed to secure the kill.
Jax.laning: Keep the lane pushed toward you and last-hit minions to restore health and mana with Cho'Gath P Carnivore. Pressure with your jungler while Jax E Counter Strike is on cooldown, and don’t spend abilities just because he activates Counter Strike and approaches. During lane, build Cho'Gath R Feast stacks up to the cap by using it to kill minions or regular jungle monsters.
Jax.combo: When Jax E Counter Strike ends, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, then knock Jax up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture as soon as Jax Q Leap Strike is unavailable. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land your remaining empowered E basic attacks. If you think he’ll dodge Rupture with Jax Q Leap Strike, silence him first with W to lock down his mobility, then place Q, but account for the fact that he can still walk out of it while silenced.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike, he has no mobility available. If Jax E Counter Strike has also ended, engage with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Don’t engage while Counter Strike is active or when you need to avoid its recast stun; move outside its range instead.
Jax.phase: Cho'Gath gains an advantage as the game goes on and he builds Feast stacks, so keep stacking.
Jax.teamfight: Stand in front of your allies and place Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Jax’s approach path. If he jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, don’t group up nearby; move outside the stun’s range. Use Cho'Gath R Feast to finish the enemy’s main damage dealer directly once their health has been reduced enough, and take the stack.

Jayce.watch: When Jayce places Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so move sideways out of its line. When Jayce is holding his hammer, watch out for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first to mitigate the damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Magic resistance won’t block the damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer can reduce your resistances, so build movement speed to dodge attacks instead of stacking only resistances.
Jayce.fight: Close the distance right after Jayce uses Jayce Q To the Skies! and look for a chance to knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Before then, don’t force trades against ranged Jayce, and back off if Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses.
Jayce.laning: Early on, move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast and focus on last-hitting safely. Restore health and mana with Cho'Gath P Carnivore, and clear minions by piercing them with Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. If Jayce pushes the wave, look for an opportunity to call your jungler for a gank.
Jayce.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes before engaging, then slow Jayce with empowered basic attacks. If Jayce Q To the Skies! is available and he might use it to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If Jayce Q To the Skies! is already on cooldown, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, cast Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land your remaining empowered basic attacks.
Jayce.escape: The moment after Jayce uses Jayce Q To the Skies! is your window to engage. If he is in hammer stance and Jayce E Thundering Blow's knockback has also been used, close the distance and catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Jayce.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger as he builds stacks, so surviving the early game and continuing to grow makes the matchup increasingly favorable.
Jayce.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front by placing Cho'Gath Q Rupture where Jayce is approaching, and silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to cast a spell. Look for a chance to engage once Jayce Q To the Skies! is on cooldown, and use Cho'Gath R Feast to secure the kill on Jayce once his health has been reduced enough, gaining a stack.

KSante.watch: If you’ve been hit by consecutive casts of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, the next shockwave will pull and stun you, so move out of range. Don’t stand with your back to a wall, to avoid being knocked away by K'Sante R All Out.
KSante.build: Crowd control chained from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, K'Sante W Path Maker, and K'Sante R All Out is dangerous, so prioritize tenacity. If you build resistances, choose armor, and also build health to withstand the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker.
KSante.fight: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and take short trades, but back off if Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses. After K'Sante finishes charging K'Sante W Path Maker and dashes, lock down his remaining mobility with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then look for Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If K'Sante activates K'Sante R All Out, focus your damage on his reduced health and resistances, but don’t take on his increased damage and life steal alone.
KSante.laning: During this window, K'Sante also has only K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes available, so take the chance to safely wear down his health.
KSante.combo: If K'Sante could dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with K'Sante E Footwork or K'Sante W Path Maker, silence him first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If his mobility is on cooldown, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and engage with empowered basic attacks, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then cast Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne and land your remaining empowered basic attacks. Finish with Cho'Gath R Feast once his health is low enough to kill him.
KSante.escape: Look to engage after both K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork are on cooldown, and before K'Sante R All Out is available again. If the empowered shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes is ready, dodge it from outside its range before engaging. In that window, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and stop his follow-up abilities with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream.
KSante.phase: In the mid game, build Cho'Gath R Feast stacks before K'Sante has accumulated defensive items, and trade when his mobility is on cooldown. In the late game, stacked Cho'Gath has the advantage, so hold the front line and fight.
KSante.teamfight: As Cho'Gath, protect your allies from the front by placing Cho'Gath Q Rupture where K'Sante is approaching to delay his engage. Don’t use crowd control while K'Sante is charging K'Sante W Path Maker; move out of its dash path, then block his follow-up abilities with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. When K'Sante is in K'Sante R All Out, focus your damage with your team, and use Cho'Gath R Feast on the enemy’s main damage dealer once their health is low enough to secure the kill.

Kennen.watch: Kennen’s P Mark of the Storm stuns after it stacks three times, so back off when you have two marks and wait for them to expire. Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and spread out in teamfights so multiple allies aren’t caught in Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom’s AoE stun.
Kennen.fight: Don’t force your way onto Kennen early. Trade back after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. If Kennen might dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with E Lightning Rush, silence him first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then look for Q.
Kennen.laning: Stand behind minions to block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and only step forward briefly to last-hit. Clear minions with Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes and use Cho'Gath P Carnivore to recover. If Kennen pushes the wave into you, keep the lane pulled back and call for a jungle gank.
Kennen.combo: If Kennen E Lightning Rush is ready, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance. Once in range, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, follow with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then land the remaining empowered E attacks. If Q misses, back off.
Kennen.escape: The window for Cho'Gath to engage is after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks have expired. If Kennen E Lightning Rush is ready, lock him down first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then look for Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Kennen.phase: If you survive the early game while building Feast stacks, Cho'Gath becomes more favored as the game goes on.
Kennen.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front and make sure they don’t overlap in the path of Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom’s engage. Place Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Kennen’s path, and silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream just as he tries to cast a spell. Kennen gains resistances while his R is active, so finish him with the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast only when his health is low enough to secure the kill.
Kennen.build: After that, build magic resistance to match Kennen’s magic damage, and consider movement speed so you can leave the warned area.

Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast lowers Cho'Gath’s magic resistance and slows him, so dodge it. Kayle can heal and create distance with Kayle W Celestial Blessing, and she takes no damage while Kayle R Divine Judgment is active. Use Cho'Gath Q Rupture to keep her occupied during her invulnerability, then attack after it ends.
Kayle.build: If Kayle is surviving through Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s healing, fit Morellonomicon into your build and maintain healing reduction with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Prioritize magic resistance for defense, but dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast to get value from it.
Kayle.fight: Hit Kayle with Cho'Gath Q Rupture when she steps forward to last-hit, then silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while she’s airborne and continue attacking. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back off. Don’t rush to finish her with Cho'Gath R Feast while Kayle R Divine Judgment is ready.
Kayle.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes before closing in, then approach with empowered attacks. When Kayle steps forward to last-hit, knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while she’s airborne, then land the remaining empowered attacks. If Kayle used Kayle R Divine Judgment, finish her with Cho'Gath R Feast after the invulnerability ends, when her health is in kill range.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility spell, so look for a chance to approach after Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses. It’s important to land Cho'Gath Q Rupture before she escapes with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, don’t chase; back off.
Kayle.teamfight: Cho'Gath should protect allies from the front and look for a chance to reach Kayle when allied crowd control can also connect. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, use Cho'Gath Q Rupture to keep her occupied during her invulnerability, then deal damage after it ends. If you can reliably finish Kayle with Cho'Gath R Feast after her health has been reduced enough, take the kill yourself and gain the stack.

Kled.watch: If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, immediately create distance before he pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off to avoid the fourth attack’s max-health damage, then re-engage. Watch for engages chained from Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and interrupt the chase when he gets close with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream.
Kled.build: Build armor first to counter Kled’s main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, Kled W Violent Tendencies, and Kled E Jousting. If crowd control is getting you killed, prioritize tenacity. You can also lower his attack speed to buy time to get away before Kled W Violent Tendencies finishes its four attacks.
Kled.fight: Keep your distance early, last-hit to recover with Cho'Gath P Carnivore, and look for trades once Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream are available. Re-engage after dodging Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope’s pull and Kled W Violent Tendencies’ four attacks. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, don’t continue the trade; back off.
Kled.laning: Keep the lane pulled back and survive the early game by last-hitting to restore health and mana with Cho'Gath P Carnivore. If Kled dismounts from Skaarl, watch his Courage meter. If you can’t secure the kill, create distance and limit his opportunities to build Courage. To preserve the advantage of dismounting him, push him out of lane so he can’t kill minions.
Kled.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance. If Kled might dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Kled E Jousting, silence him first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If you can read his movement, such as when he steps forward to last-hit, knock him up first with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land the rest of your empowered attacks. If his health is low enough to kill, finish with Cho'Gath R Feast.
Kled.escape: Don’t engage hastily when only Kled E Jousting is down, since he can escape with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. Look for an opening before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up. If Kled E Jousting is also down, you have a chance to catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Engage only if you haven’t been caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Kled.phase: If you avoid forcing fights until midgame and build Feast stacks, Cho'Gath becomes more favored as Kled’s strength falls off in the late game.
Kled.teamfight: Use flank vision to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! coming in. If you can’t stop it, stand in front as Cho'Gath and protect your backline’s formation. Place Cho'Gath Q Rupture in his path, and silence Kled with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to cast a spell. Don’t overextend at the frontline. Use Cho'Gath R Feast on the enemy’s main damage dealer whose health is low enough for you to secure the kill.

Malphite.watch: If you’re hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, the slow makes it harder to engage or retreat, so don’t start a trade immediately afterward.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. For offense, use Cho'Gath’s magic damage and the max-health damage from E Vorpal Spikes instead of trying to punch through Malphite’s armor directly.
Malphite.fight: Start trading only after breaking Malphite P Granite Shield and when you can damage his actual health. Don’t force an engage while slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard. Look for an engage with Cho'Gath Q Rupture after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down.
Malphite.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and break the shield with basic attacks. Then knock Malphite up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and land the remaining empowered E attacks. If Q misses, back off.
Malphite.escape: At this point, it’s easier to land Cho'Gath Q Rupture’s delayed eruption if you place it when Malphite steps forward to last-hit with a basic attack.
Malphite.phase: Afterward, watch for Malphite’s ultimate while building Cho'Gath R Feast stacks to strengthen your late-game advantage.
Malphite.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front by placing Cho'Gath Q Rupture in the enemy’s engage path, and look to silence Malphite with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream before he uses R Unstoppable Force. Once his charge begins, don’t try to interrupt it; spread out from your allies so he can’t knock several of you up at once. Counterattack after Malphite’s R is down, and finish the enemy’s main damage dealer whose health is low enough with Cho'Gath R Feast.

Mordekaiser.watch: Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can pull in multiple enemies, so don’t group with allies directly in front of him. When Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise is active, its max-health-based damage and movement speed increase mean that the longer you stay close, the more you lose out. While Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first to handle the magic damage from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, Q Obliterate, and E Death's Grasp. Get armor too to reduce his basic attack damage, but avoid building only health because P Darkness Rise deals damage based on max health. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Mordekaiser.laning: Keep the lane pushed toward you and stay at a distance directly in front of Mordekaiser so he can’t pull you in with E Death's Grasp.
Mordekaiser.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, get close and land an empowered basic attack, then knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and silence him with W Feral Scream while he’s airborne. Land the remaining empowered E basic attacks, but back away if Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Don’t continue the fight if Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses.
Mordekaiser.escape: The moment Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses is your chance to engage. Mordekaiser has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and block his next ability with W Feral Scream. However, while Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger as he stacks, making the late game favorable, so fill out the Feast stacks obtainable from minion kills during the laning phase.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Stand in front of your team, place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Mordekaiser’s approach, and silence him with W Feral Scream as he tries to use a key ability. Keep your distance from allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can’t pull in several of you. If you can reliably kill the enemy’s main damage dealer whose health has been reduced, finish them with Cho'Gath R Feast to gain a stack.
Mordekaiser.fight: Early on, trade only once or twice, then back off so Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise does not activate. After Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and engage. Focus your damage after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield wears down or it converts into healing. If you have lowered his health enough to kill him, finish with Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement speed and attack speed, so don’t fight alone in its range for long. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, his health and defensive stats increase; if you don’t have a clear advantage, avoid fighting and wait out its duration. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so leave the area.
Nasus.build: Nasus’s main damage, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, is physical, so build armor first. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire or R Fury of the Sands, so don’t stay on Nasus E Spirit Fire.
Nasus.fight: Look for Cho'Gath Q Rupture when Nasus steps up to last-hit a minion with Q Siphoning Strike. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, don’t fight him without a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: Don’t push the lane toward Nasus’s turret, where he can comfortably stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Let the lane come toward you, call for a jungle gank, and secure minion last hits to heal with Cho'Gath P Carnivore.
Nasus.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes before getting close and start with an empowered basic attack. When Nasus steps forward to last-hit, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land the remaining empowered basic attacks. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back off.
Nasus.escape: After Nasus W Wither is down is a good window to engage. Nasus has no way to create distance except Flash, so catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture when he steps up to last-hit. If Nasus W Wither is still available, don’t engage him alone in its range.
Nasus.phase: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks up over time, so build Cho'Gath R Feast stacks for the late game and deny Nasus his last hits.
Nasus.teamfight: Stand in front of your team, place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Nasus’s approach, and silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to use a key ability. Don’t keep facing down Nasus while his R Fury of the Sands is active; maintain your distance. Reliably finish the enemy’s main damage dealer once their health is low enough with Cho'Gath R Feast to gain a stack.

Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, so move away from where the axe lands. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor can’t reduce, so create distance when your health is low. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t try to catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture; wait behind your allies for its duration to end.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Olaf E Reckless Swing can’t be reduced by resistances, so get health too. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, reducing his attack speed is also effective.
Olaf.fight: Once Olaf R Ragnarok ends, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and finish him with Cho'Gath R Feast when his health is low enough.
Olaf.laning: Keep the lane pushed toward you and secure last hits to sustain with Cho'Gath P Carnivore’s health and mana recovery. Move opposite the direction Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands to make it harder for him to retrieve. Avoid giving up an early kill while filling out the Cho'Gath R Feast stacks obtainable from minion kills.
Olaf.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and start the trade with a basic attack. When Olaf R Ragnarok has ended or hasn’t been activated, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land the remaining empowered E basic attacks. If Q misses, back off.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so prevent him from retrieving Olaf Q Undertow’s axe and engage after Olaf R Ragnarok ends. Catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture then, but if Olaf activates R, don’t stay close and fight; create distance.
Olaf.phase: In the mid game, build Cho'Gath R Feast stacks and look for opportunities to fight. Cho'Gath becomes favored in the late game with stacks, but you can’t count on that advantage if you miss out on stacks.
Olaf.teamfight: Protect your team from the front and prepare Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Olaf’s approach. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t try to stop him with Q; create distance, then interrupt his engage with Q and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream when it ends. Gain a stack when you can reliably kill the enemy’s main damage dealer whose health has been reduced with Cho'Gath R Feast.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted champion, so avoid entering its range. When he pokes with Pantheon Q Comet Spear, keep minions between you. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon’s main damage is physical, so buy armor items first. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon uses E Aegis Assault, don’t deal damage from the front; wait until it ends or reposition to his side.
Pantheon.laning: Keep the lane pushed toward you and secure minion last hits to sustain with Cho'Gath P Carnivore. Keep minions between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and don’t give him a kill by forcing an early trade.
Pantheon.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, close in with a basic attack, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land the remaining empowered basic attacks. If Pantheon is likely to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with W Shield Vault, first lock down his movement ability with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Pantheon.escape: The window to engage is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is ready again. Knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture then and follow up with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to silence him.
Pantheon.teamfight: Protect your team from the front, place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Pantheon’s approach, and silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to use a key ability. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its area. Use Cho'Gath R Feast when you can reliably kill the enemy’s main damage dealer whose health has been reduced.

Ornn.watch: Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture leaves a pillar that Ornn E Searing Charge can collide with, so avoid the pillar and nearby walls, and back toward open space. If Ornn W Bellows Breath’s final flame hits you, keep your distance until Brittle wears off. After dodging the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God, watch out for its return path.
Ornn.build: Ornn’s crowd control makes it hard to escape, so consider tenacity first. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so think carefully before stacking health alone.
Ornn.fight: Keep your distance while Ornn still has his mobility. Start trades with Cho'Gath Q Rupture after Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down. If Ornn might use a mobility spell to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, but look for the moment he steps up to last-hit with a basic attack since he can dodge it on foot.
Ornn.laning: Keep the wave pulled toward you and stand away from walls and the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture. If Ornn tries to craft an item, move in and attack to interrupt him.
Ornn.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, close in with an empowered attack, then knock Ornn up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he is airborne, then land your remaining empowered attacks. If Ornn might dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream first. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back away.
Ornn.escape: When only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, Ornn can still escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, so don’t go too deep. In particular, the window to hit Cho'Gath Q Rupture and engage is after Ornn E Searing Charge is used, before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back.
Ornn.phase: Cho'Gath becomes more advantageous in the mid and late game as Cho'Gath R Feast stacks accumulate, but start pressuring Ornn before his items and his allies’ masterwork upgrades accumulate.
Ornn.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front by placing Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Ornn’s approach, and silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream just as he tries to use a key ability. Move out of the line between Ornn R Call of the Forge God’s spirit and Ornn, and avoid the return path too. Secure a kill with Cho'Gath R Feast on an enemy primary damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently depleted, and gain a stack.

Quinn.watch: When marked by Quinn P Harrier, move out of Quinn’s basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Stand behind minions to avoid the first hit of Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and don’t try to engage alone while Quinn E Vault is available.
Quinn.build: Build armor first early on. Armor is more effective than magic resistance since Quinn’s main damage is physical.
Quinn.fight: Start a trade when Quinn E Vault is down or your allied jungler arrives. If Quinn E Vault is still available, silence her first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then look for Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Quinn.laning: Early on, preserve your health, last-hit minions, and recover with Cho'Gath P Carnivore. Clear minions by piercing them with Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, and call your allied jungler if Quinn pushes the wave.
Quinn.combo: When you get a chance to close in, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, slow Quinn with a basic attack, then knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while she is airborne, then land your remaining empowered attacks. If Quinn might dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Quinn E Vault, use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream first.
Quinn.escape: Immediately after Quinn E Vault has been used is your chance to engage Quinn. Look for Cho'Gath Q Rupture then; if it misses, don’t chase further and back away.
Quinn.phase: Cho'Gath grows stronger as he gains stacks, so build minion Feast stacks during laning for the late game.
Quinn.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front. If Quinn comes in from the flank, knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture or silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. When Quinn’s health has been sufficiently depleted and you can reliably kill her, finish her with Cho'Gath R Feast and gain a stack.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so think carefully before building health alone. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.fight: Cho'Gath has no mobility spell to escape with, so manage your distance and stay away from walls. When Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and trade with empowered attacks from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Even if Poppy’s health is low, her armor may be higher, so finish her with Cho'Gath R Feast when you can secure the kill.
Poppy.laning: Keep the wave pulled toward you and don’t stand with your back to a wall, to avoid the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you can safely step on Poppy’s thrown shield, step on it first to prevent her from gaining a shield.
Poppy.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and start the trade with a basic attack. If Poppy can dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Poppy E Heroic Charge, silence her first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then place Q. If Poppy E Heroic Charge is already down, knock her up with Q, use W while she is airborne, then land your remaining empowered attacks from E.
Poppy.phase: If you survive the early game and build Feast stacks, you’ll become more advantageous as the game goes on.
Poppy.escape: Right after you make Poppy use E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the distance. Knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and trade, but back off if Q misses. You can also use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to lock out Poppy E Heroic Charge before going in.
Poppy.teamfight: Place Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Poppy's approach path in front of your allies, then silence her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream when she is about to use a key ability. If you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict charging, move sideways out of its path. Use Cho'Gath R Feast to secure a takedown and gain a stack when an enemy's main damage dealer is low enough to kill.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so stay in open space rather than with your back to a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you with its first strike, walk out of the zone before the second strike detonates. When Poppy R Keeper's Verdict is charging, move out of its path and dodge to the side.

Riven.watch: If Riven closes in repeatedly with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, Cho'Gath will have a hard time escaping on his own.
Riven.fight: The moment after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions is your chance to counterattack. If Riven engages first, interrupt her remaining abilities with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then knock her up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and continue the trade. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back away.
Riven.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes before engaging. After a basic attack, knock Riven up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream on her while she is airborne and land your remaining empowered attacks.
Riven.phase: As you build Feast stacks, the matchup becomes more favorable as the game goes on, but if you miss out on stacks, it’s hard to make the most of your strength even in the late game.
Riven.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front by placing Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Riven’s approach, and interrupt her with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream when she closes in to chain abilities. Hold the frontline since it’s hard to return after pushing too far without a mobility spell. Secure a kill with Cho'Gath R Feast on an enemy primary damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently depleted, and gain a stack.
Riven.build: All of Riven's damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven starts pulling ahead, buy defensive items sooner, and get enough health to avoid being finished off by Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.escape: Don't go in just because Riven E Valor is down; look for a window before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back. If Riven used Q Broken Wings on minions or W Ki Burst is also down, that's an opportunity to land Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Riven.laning: Let the wave push toward you to manage the distance, then look for an opening when Riven uses Q Broken Wings on minions. After learning Cho'Gath R Feast, fill the cap on stacks gained from killing minions during the laning phase.

Renekton.watch: Renekton E Slice and Dice unlocks a second dash if the first hits a unit, so don’t stand in or behind a minion wave.
Renekton.laning: Let the wave push toward you, then poke with Cho'Gath Q Rupture when Renekton approaches minions to build Fury. Avoid standing in or behind a minion wave that Renekton E Slice and Dice could use as a stepping stone.
Renekton.combo: When you can lead with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne, then land your remaining Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes empowered attacks.
Renekton.phase: From the mid game onward, Renekton becomes less valuable, while Cho'Gath grows stronger with each stack, so keep collecting Feast stacks.
Renekton.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front by placing Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Renekton’s path of entry, then silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to cast a skill. Don’t overextend; hit the frontline with Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Use Cho'Gath R Feast on an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently depleted to secure the kill and a stack.
Renekton.build: Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Renekton E Slice and Dice’s empowered recast shreds armor, so position yourself to dodge the dash. If Renekton is sustaining through trades with Renekton Q Cull the Meek, fit Morellonomicon into your build.
Renekton.escape: The window to engage is after Renekton has already used Renekton E Slice and Dice or after Renekton has used Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Especially if Renekton used Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage, catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and trade when Renekton P Reign of Anger’s bar is empty.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton P Reign of Anger’s bar is empty, and retaliate after Renekton has used Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Renekton used Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage, block the escape route with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and close the distance. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, stop trading and back away.

Rumble.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and slow him with an attack, then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture as Rumble steps forward to last-hit. While he’s airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land your remaining empowered attacks. Use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream first when you need to stop Rumble from casting a key ability, but remember he can still walk to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture while silenced.
Rumble.phase: Building Feast stacks makes the matchup more favorable for Cho'Gath as the game goes on, so collect the stacks available from minions during lane phase.
Rumble.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front by placing Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Rumble’s path of entry to delay him. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to cast a key ability. Personally finish an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently depleted with Cho'Gath R Feast, and gain a stack.
Rumble.build: Prioritize defensive items with magic resistance. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on health stacking alone.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so the window to catch him is after the movement speed boost and shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield expire. If you get hit by Rumble E Electro Harpoon, create distance before the second shot, then look for an opening to go in after dodging it. On the engage, use the knockup and slow from Cho'Gath Q Rupture to reduce the time Rumble has to get away.
Rumble.fight: Fight where Rumble has to walk forward, and limit how long you stay in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter. Let the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield expire, then catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture for a short trade. Back off if Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't stay in its cone for long. If you get hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, immediately create distance to avoid the second shot, its stronger slow, and its magic resistance reduction. Don't pour damage into Rumble W Scrap Shield while it's active.

Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are enemies on both sides of Sett, so position yourself to avoid standing on the opposite side of Sett from a minion wave. Sett W Haymaker gets stronger after he takes damage, so create distance right after dealing damage; when he casts it, dodge sideways from the center of its aim. Sett R The Show Stopper grabs and throws you, so focus on managing your distance while his ultimate is available.
Sett.build: Build armor first against Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down, his main sources of damage. Avoid the center of Sett W Haymaker first, since resistance cannot reduce its true damage. Be careful about stacking health alone, since Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your max health.
Sett.fight: Cho'Gath has no skill to escape once caught, so manage your distance to avoid Sett E Facebreaker’s stun positioning. While Sett R The Show Stopper is down, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and start a fight.
Sett.laning: Keep the wave pushed toward you. When Sett gets close and commits to a direction, place Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then lock down his chase skill with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. During lane phase, also build up the maximum number of minion stacks available from Cho'Gath R Feast.
Sett.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and start the trade with empowered attacks. When Sett steps forward to last-hit, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he’s airborne and land your remaining empowered attacks.
Sett.escape: Check your position relative to both sides of Sett so Sett E Facebreaker doesn’t stun you, even if it hits. If you dealt enough damage after engaging to strengthen Sett W Haymaker, create distance, then re-engage.
Sett.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front by placing Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Sett’s path of entry. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to cast a key ability, and dodge sideways from the center of Sett W Haymaker’s aim. Secure the kill on an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently depleted with Cho'Gath R Feast to gain a stack.
Sett.phase: As the game goes on, Cho'Gath gets stronger with each Feast stack, so keep building them steadily.

Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you’re likely to be hit by Shen Q Twilight Assault’s empowered basic attacks, so dodge the dash. Also move out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault’s returning spirit blade, and stop basic attacks when Shen W Spirit's Refuge appears.
Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity against Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so build resistances without overcommitting to either type. Avoid relying on health alone, since Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your max health.
Shen.fight: Retaliate if Shen E Shadow Dash misses, and back off if Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses.
Shen.laning: Last-hit to sustain through the early game with Cho'Gath P Carnivore’s health and mana recovery. If Shen leaves with his ultimate and the lane is empty, take advantage on that side.
Shen.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, close in with a basic attack, then knock Shen up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Follow with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream on the airborne Shen, then your remaining empowered basic attacks. If Shen looks likely to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Shen E Shadow Dash, silence him first with Feral Scream, then place Rupture. While Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, hold your basic attacks and resume them after it ends.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is an opportunity to engage. If Shen can still use Shen R Stand United, don’t overextend just because Shen E Shadow Dash is down; look for a chance to hit Cho'Gath Q Rupture before his ultimate comes back.
Shen.phase: Get through the early game while building Feast stacks; the matchup becomes more favorable for Cho'Gath as the game goes on.
Shen.teamfight: Protect your allies from the front by placing Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Shen’s path of entry, then silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream just before he casts a key ability. Don’t overextend; secure the kill on an enemy main damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently depleted with Cho'Gath R Feast to gain a stack.

Singed.build: Build magic resistance first. Both Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling deal magic damage, and stacking only health also increases Fling’s health-based damage. Get enough movement speed to walk out of Q Poison Trail.
Singed.fight: If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back off instead of following through the poison.
Singed.laning: Cho'Gath W Feral Scream costs a lot of mana early, so do not use it too often.
Singed.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and slow Singed with an empowered attack, then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture where Singed steps up to last-hit. While he is airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land your remaining empowered attacks. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, end the trade and back away.
Singed.escape: The window to go in opens after Singed uses Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling. Approach by going around the adhesive, then catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture after slowing him with Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Singed has no skill to create distance on his own, but do not pursue him all the way while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.phase: Singed becomes difficult to catch once he completes his core items in the mid game, but Cho'Gath grows stronger as he gains stacks, giving him the advantage later in the game.
Singed.teamfight: Place Cho'Gath Q Rupture in the path Singed will take as he runs at your team to hold him in place and give your team time to attack his. Use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream when you need to stop an important enemy ability, and do not chase Singed beyond the poison. Hold the frontline, then use Cho'Gath R Feast to secure a kill on the enemy’s primary damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently depleted.
Singed.watch: Don't chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. Go around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive, and keep your distance so you don't get hit by Singed E Fling while standing in it. If Singed has his back to your allies, he can use E Fling to throw you into their formation, so don't stand in front of him.

Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, dodge to the side instead of backing away. Do not face Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge to the side. Even after you kill Sion, Sion P Glory in Death brings him back, so do not keep fighting there—create distance again.
Sion.build: Build armor first against Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, his main sources of damage. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor, so keep moving to avoid it even after building armor.
Sion.fight: Sidestep the charge of Sion Q Decimating Smash, then trade. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus your damage to break the shield before it bursts. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back off instead of chasing.
Sion.laning: If you keep giving Sion CS, his maximum health will increase, so disrupt his farming or find an advantage in another lane.
Sion.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and close in with an empowered attack, then knock Sion up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. While he is airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land your remaining empowered attacks. Sion can still walk out of the way while silenced, so look for a moment when his movement is restricted.
Sion.escape: When Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, you have an opening to catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and go in. Also look to trade after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash’s charged attack to the side.
Sion.phase: If you survive the early game while building Feast stacks, Cho'Gath gains the advantage later, but you still need to keep pressuring Sion's CS.
Sion.teamfight: Stand in front of your team and place Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Sion's path of entry. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream just as he is about to use an ability. Do not go too far forward; build stacks with Cho'Gath R Feast when you can reliably kill the enemy's primary damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently reduced. If you kill Sion, create distance again while Sion P Glory in Death is active.

TahmKench.watch: When you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies so you are not hit together by its area knock-up.
TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Tahm Kench's main damage. If trades drag on because of Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and the healing from Tahm Kench E Thick Skin, fit Morellonomicon into your build.
TahmKench.fight: Close the distance when there are no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down. Since he relies on Tahm Kench E Thick Skin to endure fights, look for an all-in that includes the maximum-health-based damage from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes instead of hitting briefly and backing off. Back away if Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses.
TahmKench.laning: Let the wave push toward you to manage the distance. If there are two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks, wait out of range for them to disappear. Also build up to the cap on minion-kill stacks from Cho'Gath R Feast during the laning phase.
TahmKench.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, approach, and land an empowered attack. Then place Cho'Gath Q Rupture where Tahm Kench steps up to last-hit with an attack. While he is airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land your remaining empowered attacks. If Tahm Kench looks ready to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, silence him first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then look to land Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
TahmKench.phase: Cho'Gath gains the advantage as he builds Feast stacks, so keep collecting them for the late game.
TahmKench.escape: Go in when Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down and he has no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks. Knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to silence his chasing abilities. Cho'Gath has no ability to disengage, so don't go deep if both abilities miss.
