TahmKench.teamfight: Place Cho'Gath Q Rupture in Tahm Kench's approach path in front of your allies, then silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream when he is about to use a key ability. Tahm Kench can swallow his team's main damage dealer with R Devour, so check whether the ability is available before using Cho'Gath R Feast. Use Cho'Gath R Feast to secure a takedown and gain a stack when an enemy's main damage dealer is low enough to kill.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, and he stuns you if he catches you and knocks you into a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. The more hits you take at close quarters from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval empowered attacks and Skarner P Threads of Vibration, the more dangerous they become, so do not let him get into melee range. Skarner R Impale cannot be interrupted while he is casting with Cho'Gath Q Rupture or Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, so dodge before you enter its range.
Skarner.fight: Keep your distance while Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available instead of engaging first. Right after he uses it, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and follow with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to silence him as you trade. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, stop chasing and back away.
Skarner.laning: Let the wave push toward you and take a position where you are not backed against a wall. When Skarner gets close and commits to a direction, use Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to stop his pursuit.
Skarner.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and start the trade with an empowered attack. Knock Skarner up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he is airborne and land your remaining empowered attacks. He can still walk out of the way while silenced, so look for the moment he steps up to last-hit.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner uses Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your window to close the distance. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture hits then, Skarner cannot escape with a movement ability, and you can trade while using Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to stop his follow-up abilities. Once Skarner R Impale is cast, Cho'Gath's silence or knock-up cannot interrupt it, so be careful about entering its range.
Skarner.phase: Cho'Gath gains the advantage later as he builds Feast stacks, but Skarner also becomes tankier and deals more damage as he completes items, so take opportunities to scale from the early game.
Skarner.build: Buy magic resistance items first to account for Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale damage. Magic resistance doesn't help against Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or E Ixtal's Impact. His abilities also include damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on health stacking alone. Get movement speed to walk out of telegraphed areas, and consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar if you need a way to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale.

Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart causes your basic attacks to miss, so don’t try to use Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes’ empowered attack while blinded. Teemo R Noxious Trap is hidden and slows, so watch your step near objectives and in narrow passages.
Teemo.build: Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap deal primarily magic damage, so build magic resistance first. When preparing for a team fight, use Oracle Lens to clear traps from key routes.
Teemo.fight: Early on, avoid trades where you take one basic attack enhanced by Teemo E Toxic Shot and then back off. When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is on cooldown or Teemo steps up to last-hit, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and engage; back off if it misses.
Teemo.laning: Don’t force your way toward ranged Teemo. Use Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes to clear through minions and secure last hits to heal with Cho'Gath P Carnivore. If Teemo pushes the wave, keep it near your side and call for an allied jungler to gank. To avoid Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, go around bushes without vision or check them with a Control Ward.
Teemo.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes before engaging. After Teemo Q Blinding Dart is on cooldown, slow him with an empowered attack and hit Cho'Gath Q Rupture. While Teemo is airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land your remaining empowered attacks. Finish with Cho'Gath R Feast when he is low enough to kill.
Teemo.escape: The moment after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used is your chance to engage and land basic attacks. If Teemo W Move Quick seems likely to help him dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then cast Q. Teemo can still walk out of the way while silenced, so aim for a moment when his movement is restricted.
Teemo.teamfight: Stand in front of your allies and place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along the routes enemies may use to engage. Silence enemies with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream when they are about to use key abilities. Near objectives and in narrow passages, use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap. Use Cho'Gath R Feast when you can reliably finish off the enemy team's primary damage dealer whose health has been reduced.
Teemo.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger as he builds stacks, but Teemo can set more traps if given time, so check key paths as you move.

Trundle.watch: Trundle gains powerful attack speed and healing inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, so retreat outside it and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks escape routes and slows nearby enemies, so fight in open terrain and move sideways as soon as the pillar appears. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on your max health and steals your resistances, so create distance while it is active.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, your resistances are less effective, and the more health you build, the more damage it deals, so prioritize creating distance over stacking more resistances or health. If Trundle survives through Trundle P King's Tribute healing, fit in Morellonomicon and maintain Grievous Wounds with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes.
Trundle.fight: Don’t fight inside Trundle W Frozen Domain. Wait out its duration from outside, then engage again. Once Trundle E Pillar of Ice is on cooldown and you have an angle to catch him in open terrain, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture to engage. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, don’t chase; back off.
Trundle.laning: Trundle P King's Tribute also heals when nearby units die, so don’t drag out fights that only chip away at health while a large wave is nearby.
Trundle.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes before engaging and land an empowered attack, then knock Trundle up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. While he is airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land your remaining empowered attacks from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, disengage. Finish with Cho'Gath R Feast when you have dealt enough damage to ensure the kill.
Trundle.escape: The window after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is used is a good time to engage. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you hit Cho'Gath Q Rupture when you have an angle to catch him, it will be difficult for him to escape.
Trundle.teamfight: Protect your allies at the front and place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Trundle’s approach routes. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream just as he is about to use a key ability. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, create distance or target someone else instead of continuing to attack Trundle. When you can reliably finish off the enemy team's primary damage dealer whose health has been reduced, use Cho'Gath R Feast to secure the kill and gain a stack.

Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury critical strikes become more threatening as he builds Fury by hitting minions, so create distance when you see him building it up. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash lets him close in, and he cannot die while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, so use Cho'Gath Q Rupture to knock him up and buy time. When retreating, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.build: Build armor first against Tryndamere’s physical damage and critical strikes, and consider Thornmail against an opponent who relies on basic attacks. If Tryndamere survives through healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust, fit in Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds.
Tryndamere.fight: Hit Tryndamere with Cho'Gath Q Rupture just after he uses Tryndamere E Spinning Slash to block his escape. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, create distance and focus your damage after it ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere to make last-hitting difficult and prevent him from building Fury. Secure last hits to restore Cho'Gath’s health and mana with Cho'Gath P Carnivore, and keep the wave near your side. After learning Cho'Gath R Feast, fill the stacks available from minions or regular jungle monsters during the laning phase.
Tryndamere.combo: If Tryndamere E Spinning Slash seems likely to help him dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture. If Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is already on cooldown, close in with an empowered attack from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he is airborne, then land your remaining empowered attacks. Back off if Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses.
Tryndamere.escape: The moment after you make Tryndamere use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is Cho'Gath’s window to engage. Hit him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture to stop his movement and trade. Even if Tryndamere W Mocking Shout is on cooldown, don’t force an extended basic-attack fight if he has built up Fury.
Tryndamere.phase: Cho'Gath becomes more favorable as the game goes on and you gain stacks, so keep securing stacks with Cho'Gath R Feast through mid game and beyond.
Tryndamere.teamfight: When Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, buy time with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then reliably finish off the enemy team's primary damage dealer whose health has been reduced with Cho'Gath R Feast after it ends. Don’t try to hold a side lane alone while Tryndamere’s ultimate is ready; trade for an objective or send more players.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede lets him approach quickly and stun you, so don’t move forward when Udyr is out of sight. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E is Awakened, so use Cho'Gath Q Rupture after the Awakened effect ends. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on health alone to withstand them for long.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr. Keep in mind that armor won’t block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both types of damage. If Udyr survives through healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle, fit in Morellonomicon and maintain Grievous Wounds with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes.
Udyr.fight: The moment after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is used is your chance to close the gap. If the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is no longer present, pressure him with empowered attacks from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes so he has no time to heal. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, don’t continue the fight; back off.
Udyr.laning: Udyr may appear from the jungle to gank, so ward key routes and jungle entrances, and don’t push the lane and move forward while he is out of sight. Keep the wave near your side and secure minion last hits to restore Cho'Gath’s health and mana with Cho'Gath P Carnivore. If Udyr ganks, cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture when he closes in and commits to a direction, then lock down his pursuit ability with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream.
Udyr.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and slow Udyr with an empowered attack, then knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he is airborne. Follow with your remaining empowered attacks from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede seems likely to help him dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture, lock down his movement ability first with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Udyr.escape: If you engage just after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is used, it will be difficult for Udyr to escape with that ability. If you have already been stunned once by Udyr E Blazing Stampede, fight back or disengage while it cannot immediately stun you again. Immobilizing effects from Cho'Gath Q Rupture don’t work while Udyr E is Awakened, so use it after the effect ends.
Udyr.phase: Cho'Gath gains an advantage as you gain stacks, so fill the Cho'Gath R Feast stacks available from minions and regular jungle monsters during the laning phase.
Udyr.teamfight: Protect your allies at the front and place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Udyr’s approach routes. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream just as he is about to use an ability. Don’t force a kill on Udyr while he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle; first take down a weaker enemy within reach, then use your numbers advantage. When you can reliably finish off the enemy team's primary damage dealer whose health has been reduced, use Cho'Gath R Feast to secure the kill and gain a stack.

Urgot.watch: If Urgot E Disdain catches you, you’ll be stunned and likely hit by Urgot P Echoing Flames next, so avoid his engage angle and keep your distance. Urgot Q Corrosive Charge slows you and marks you for Urgot W Purge, so dodge it as it flies toward you. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, get completely out of its range before you reach the execution threshold.
Urgot.build: Build armor first against Urgot’s primary damage. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of relying on stacking health alone. Also account for the execution threshold on Urgot R Fear Beyond Death when considering your total health.
Urgot.fight: While Urgot E Disdain is available, don’t approach first; wait just outside his short range. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back off instead of chasing.
Urgot.laning: Secure last hits to restore health and mana with Cho'Gath P Carnivore and sustain your lane. If Urgot pushes the wave, let it come toward you and call for a jungle gank.
Urgot.combo: If Urgot is likely to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Urgot E Disdain, activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture. After knocking him up, land the remaining empowered attacks from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes and create distance. If Urgot E Disdain is already down, knock him up first with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, then use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while he is airborne.
Urgot.escape: The moment Urgot E Disdain goes on cooldown is Cho'Gath’s window to close the distance. Dodge the slow from Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, confirm Urgot E Disdain is unavailable, then engage and catch him with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. When he approaches with Urgot W Purge active, walk outside its firing range and don’t force an engage.
Urgot.teamfight: Stand in front of your team and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Urgot’s approach path. Stop his attempt to engage with Urgot E Disdain using Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. If your frontline absorbs Urgot E Disdain, the damage dealers behind them won’t get caught by the dash. Reliably kill the enemy team's primary damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently reduced with Cho'Gath R Feast to gain a stack.
Urgot.phase: The more Feast stacks Cho'Gath builds, the stronger he becomes later, so reach the cap on stacks from minions and regular jungle monsters during the laning phase.

Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash lets him close in quickly and stun you with an empowered basic attack, so stay outside his attack range and let the duration run out. When you see the indicator for Volibear E Sky Splitter, walk to the side to avoid its damage and slow. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under a turret at low health.
Volibear.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If Volibear is sustaining through Volibear W Frenzied Maul, fit in Morellonomicon and maintain Grievous Wounds with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and E Vorpal Spikes.
Volibear.fight: If Volibear is building stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm by hitting minions, don’t take a fight; fight after the stacks are gone. Volibear can heal with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, so if you don’t have a clear opportunity to finish him, don’t keep hitting an opponent whose health has been reduced—back off. Look to engage when both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer are down.
Volibear.laning: Keep the wave near your side. Once Volibear uses Volibear Q Thundering Smash to close in and his movement direction is clear, cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture and lock down his pursuit abilities with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. Also fill the minion stacks available from Cho'Gath R Feast during the laning phase.
Volibear.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes before approaching. When Volibear steps forward to last-hit, knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture, silence him with W Feral Scream, then land the remaining empowered attacks from E. If he is likely to dodge Q with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer, silence him with W first to lock down his movement ability, then cast Q. If Q misses, back off.
Volibear.escape: Don’t rush an engage when only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, since he can escape with R Stormbringer. Fight by landing Cho'Gath Q Rupture during the window when Volibear R is not yet back and Q is also down. Stay outside the range of Volibear Q’s empowered basic attack to avoid its stun.
Volibear.phase: Cho'Gath grows stronger with Feast stacks and becomes more favored later, so keep taking opportunities to scale.
Volibear.teamfight: Stand in front of your team and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Volibear’s approach path. Silence him with W Feral Scream as he tries to use Volibear Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer. Avoid fighting while Volibear P The Relentless Storm is fully stacked. Reliably kill the enemy team's primary damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently reduced with Cho'Gath R Feast to gain a stack.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your maximum health, so watch the mist’s trajectory and dodge it. Don’t fight where many graves have accumulated. If the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
Yorick.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers. If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites is difficult to deal with, fit in Morellonomicon and maintain Grievous Wounds with Cho'Gath Q Rupture and E Vorpal Spikes. Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of relying on stacking health alone.
Yorick.fight: Early on, focus on last-hitting to benefit from Cho'Gath P Carnivore rather than forcing fights. After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, clear the Mist Walkers and trade where there are few graves. When Yorick steps forward to last-hit, cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture to make its delayed effect easier to land.
Yorick.laning: Push the wave so Yorick can’t build graves while clearing minions on his side, but don’t fight where many graves have accumulated. Scale by gaining Cho'Gath R Feast stacks from minion kills.
Yorick.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and close in with empowered attacks, then knock Yorick up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. While he is airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land the remaining empowered attacks. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, stop fighting and back off.
Yorick.escape: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist and look to engage when Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Yorick has no mobility ability, so once you catch him, it’s difficult for him to create distance; knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture then and continue the fight. If Yorick W Dark Procession traps you, attack the wall to break it.
Yorick.phase: Steadily building Feast stacks favors Cho'Gath later, but missing stacks reduces your late-game advantage.
Yorick.teamfight: Protect your team from the front and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Yorick’s approach path. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to use a key ability. If the Maiden of the Mist attacks you, create distance from Yorick himself to avoid additional damage. Reliably kill the enemy team's primary damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently reduced with Cho'Gath R Feast to gain a stack.

Yone.watch: Wait outside his range while Yone prepares a whirlwind with Yone Q Mortal Steel. After Yone enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, he deals extra damage when he returns, so create distance before your health gets low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves him behind the last champion hit, so don’t stand alone at the very back of your formation just before a team fight.
Yone.build: Get movement speed first so you can walk out of telegraphed attack areas. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so build both resistances instead of focusing on one. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Yone.fight: Don’t approach first when Yone has prepared a whirlwind with Yone Q Mortal Steel. If Yone enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, use the Cho'Gath Q Rupture you have saved to knock him up and stop his return, then use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream to lock down his follow-up abilities. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, back off, since Cho'Gath has no mobility ability and can easily keep taking hits.
Yone.laning: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a whirlwind, keep your distance until the stacks expire.
Yone.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance and slow him with an empowered attack, then knock him up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Silence Yone while he is airborne with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land the remaining empowered attacks. If Yone is likely to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture with a mobility ability, use Cho'Gath W Feral Scream first to prevent him from using abilities, then cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture.
Yone.escape: Check that Yone Q Mortal Steel’s whirlwind and Yone E Soul Unbound are both down before engaging. If only one mobility ability is down, he can escape with the other, so look for a window before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back. Catch Yone with Cho'Gath Q Rupture then and fight.
Yone.phase: Reach the cap on Cho'Gath R Feast stacks from killing minions or regular jungle monsters during lane phase to build your late-game strength.
Yone.teamfight: Stand in front of your team and cast Cho'Gath Q Rupture along Yone’s engage path. Silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as he tries to use an ability. Keep your distance from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave can’t hit multiple champions at once and grant him a large shield. Kill the enemy team's primary damage dealer whose health has been sufficiently reduced with Cho'Gath R Feast to gain a stack.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the distance, so don’t linger among them. After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, watch for the next tornado knock-up and sidestep out of its line. Cho'Gath has no ability to escape on his own, so once caught, he can be hit repeatedly; keep your distance first.
Yasuo.build: Buy armor items first. Armor is effective against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. It cannot block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke before committing to a full trade. Look for an opening right after Yasuo throws his tornado and his Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks reset. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, don’t chase; back off.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, pull the lane toward your side and keep the minion wave thin to limit the platforms Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use. Last-hit to build up the health and mana recovery from Cho'Gath P Carnivore, and don’t spam Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, since it costs a lot of mana.
Yasuo.combo: Activate Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes in advance, slow with an empowered attack, then knock Yasuo up with Cho'Gath Q Rupture. While he’s airborne, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and land your remaining empowered attacks.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, his Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks reset, giving you an opening to engage. Go in with the silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream or the knock-up from Cho'Gath Q Rupture before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back. Don’t engage just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade was used once.
Yasuo.phase: Cho'Gath gains an advantage as he builds Feast stacks, so keep stacking steadily for the late game.
Yasuo.teamfight: Place Cho'Gath Q Rupture along the path Yasuo is taking to engage, in front of your allies, to slow his approach. When Yasuo is about to use a key ability, silence him with Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. Don’t push too far ahead of the frontline. Use Cho'Gath R Feast to secure the kill on the enemy team’s main damage source once their health has been reduced enough, and gain a stack.
